item.title: A review of 300+ Chinese documents shows AI distillation has moved from academic experiments to widespread industrial use, with Beijing encouraging the practice (Reuters)
item.description:
Reuters:
A review of 300+ Chinese documents shows AI distillation has moved from academic experiments to widespread industrial use, with Beijing encouraging the practice  —  Chinese entities are adopting increasingly sophisticated ways to use output from leading American AI models to train domestic rivals …

item.title: Nvidia unveils its Rubin HPC GPU with "more than 50,000" CUDA cores, up from 28,672 in the current Rubin GPU, for agentic workflows and scientific simulations (Jeffrey Kampman/Tom's Hardware)
item.description:
Jeffrey Kampman / Tom's Hardware:
Nvidia unveils its Rubin HPC GPU with “more than 50,000” CUDA cores, up from 28,672 in the current Rubin GPU, for agentic workflows and scientific simulations  —  Rubin HPC puts “over 50,000” CUDA cores on a chip, implies four-die layout  —  The Supercomputing 2026 conference is under way …

item.title: Analysis: Amazon's $17B+ planned investment in Ohio data centers is at risk after midterm voters passed restriction measures affecting three proposed projects (Rafe Rosner-Uddin/Financial Times)
item.description:
Rafe Rosner-Uddin / Financial Times:
Analysis: Amazon's $17B+ planned investment in Ohio data centers is at risk after midterm voters passed restriction measures affecting three proposed projects  —  Voter revolts across the US threaten billions in AI investment as communities turn against Big Tech's expansion

item.title: Sources: Jensen Huang's daughter remains in a senior Nvidia role; before Jensen Huang resigned, she was his de facto chief of staff with considerable authority (New York Times)
item.description:
New York Times:
Sources: Jensen Huang's daughter remains in a senior Nvidia role; before Jensen Huang resigned, she was his de facto chief of staff with considerable authority  —  Installed as her father's de facto chief of staff, Jensen Huang's daughter alienated top executives.
